nom: Chasin' Rabbits Apple Jam Scrub Foam

avis.texte: I've been using this as my everyday AM & PM cleanser for a little over a year now and it doesn't disappoint. I was skeptical when I first purchased, especially since I'm not a scented skincare person, but it truly does deeply clean & exfoliate without stripping your skin. It really cemented it for me when I had run out once and it took me a couple of weeks to get a new bottle, I saw a night and day difference in my complexion. Pair it with the mushroom essence and you won't be sorry!
I have combination skin and this exfoliating cleanser does a good job of addressing both acne and dry patches. It leaves my skin feeling smooth and clean.
